free_tier.stated: 200 MB per file on catbox.moe, no total quota — anonymous or free account. Anonymous files live until 2 years of inactivity; files tied to an account are permanent. Litterbox (sister service) takes 1 GB but expires in 1h-3d by choice.

retention.stated: Anonymous files live until 2 years of inactivity; files tied to an account are permanent

egress.terms: free direct GET from files.catbox.moe, no metering, range requests supported.

tooling: https://catbox.moe/user/api.php multipart (reqtype=fileupload, fileToUpload=@f) returns a bare URL. Official ShareX config, Chrome and Firefox extensions; many community Python/Node/Go/Rust libs. No rclone backend, no account API for listing.
chaining: unlimited anonymous uploads x 200 MB; with a free account the retention flips from '2 years idle' to permanent, which is the only path to archive semantics.
limits_note: 200 MB/file (GIF 20 MB); anonymous retention is inactivity-based; albums 500 files; .exe/.scr/.cpl/.doc*/.jar blocked; single-operator service.
